memory_update.text: NEU should be tracked as a high-priority underfollowed defense-materials chokepoint candidate because AMPAC links the company to ammonium perchlorate and solid rocket motor demand despite NEU's broader petroleum-additives identity.

PKE is a small-cap supplier candidate for composite, ablative, rocket motor/nozzle, radome, and military aircraft/UAV materials; survival to Layer 2 depends on verifying defense revenue materiality and capacity expansion linkage.

KRMN is a newly public sub-tier defense manufacturing candidate with unusually direct missile, hypersonic, strategic missile defense, UAS/counter-UAS, and space program exposure; monitor whether attention/valuation has already reduced underfollowed alpha.

The core node relation is not prime-contractor backlog alone; the better chokepoint lens is qualified inputs and capacity such as ammonium perchlorate, composite/ablative materials, payload protection, separation systems, propulsion subsystems, and certified defense manufacturing facilities.

Potential additional Layer 1B shadow candidates not included due to the four-name limit: United States Antimony for defense-critical antimony supply, HEICO for defense electronics and components, and other castings/forgings/precision-machining suppliers. These require separate evidence passes.

node: Tier-2 and Tier-3 defense manufacturing capacity
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the defense sub-tier capacity node finds one reference prime and three underfollowed supplier/material candidates. The strongest underfollowed chokepoint signal is NewMarket via AMPAC, because ammonium perchlorate is a regulated/qualified input for solid rocket motors and the company has disclosed an expansion tied to growing demand. Park Aerospace is a smaller, lower-attention composite and ablative-materials candidate tied to military aircraft, UAVs, rocket motors, nozzles, and radomes. Karman is a newly public merchant supplier of mission-critical missile, hypersonic, space, and defense subsystems, but its valuation/attention may be rising quickly after IPO. Northrop Grumman is included only as a reference anchor for solid rocket motor and prime-level context, not as the preferred underfollowed lane candidate.
